environment.description: Celery worker deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards POST requests to /api/v2/jobs to a Flask API container which enqueues task payloads directly to Redis. No request body inspection is configured on the ALB. The API container performs only Content-Type validation (application/json) and base64-encodes the 'payload' field before publishing to the Celery broker. Workers run on PyPy 7.3 runtime for performance, where bytearray slice assignment beyond capacity triggers heap corruption.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules only
